mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of marble countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of marble countertop installation is influenced by several factors, including the type and origin of the marble, slab thickness, edge profile complexity, and the total square footage required. Additional costs may arise from sink cutouts, cooktop cutouts, or specialized finishes. Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed estimates after an on-site measurement to account for all specific project requirements, ensuring transparency in pricing.
